entities.summary: The Most Reverend Charles Gabriel Angela Palmer-Buckle is a Ghanaian archbishop of the Roman Catholic Church, a former teacher, and a key figure in the political scene in Ghana. He is currently the Metropolitan Archbishop of Cape Coast. During 2005–2018 he was Archbishop of Accra, the fourth Ordinary since its establishment as a diocese. During 1993–2005 he was the first Bishop of Koforidua.
